name: Separator

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class Separator < Base
    ORIENTATIONS = %i[horizontal vertical].freeze

    # decorative: true renders role="none" for a purely visual line (hidden
    # from assistive tech). shadcn (Base UI) has no such prop: it always
    # renders a semantic separator, which is the default here too.
    def initialize(as: :div, orientation: :horizontal, decorative: false, **attrs)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid orientation: #{orientation}" unless ORIENTATIONS.include?(orientation.to_sym)

      @as = as
      @orientation = orientation.to_sym
      @decorative = decorative
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      tag(@as, **attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: role,
        aria: {orientation: aria_orientation},
        data: {slot: "separator", orientation: @orientation},
        class: [
          "shrink-0 bg-border",
          orientation_classes,
          hr_classes
        ]
      }
    end

    # <hr> already has the separator role: an explicit one would be redundant.
    def role
      return "none" if @decorative

      "separator" unless hr?
    end

    # The separator role's implicit aria-orientation is horizontal, so <hr>
    # only needs it when vertical. A decorative line has no orientation.
    def aria_orientation
      return if @decorative
      return if hr? && @orientation == :horizontal

      @orientation.to_s
    end

    def hr?
      @as.to_sym == :hr
    end

    # Tailwind's preflight sets hr { height: 0; border-top-width: 1px }: drop the
    # border (h-px already draws the line) and, when vertical, the fixed height,
    # or self-stretch can't stretch it.
    def hr_classes
      return unless hr?
      return "border-0 h-auto" if @orientation == :vertical

      "border-0"
    end

    # shadcn keys these on data-orientation via its data-horizontal:/data-vertical:
    # custom variants, which RubyUI's Tailwind setup doesn't define; the classes are
    # picked here instead. self-stretch (not h-full) fills a flex row with no fixed height.
    def orientation_classes
      return "h-px w-full" if @orientation == :horizontal

      "w-px self-stretch"
    end
  end
end

# Separator

Visually or semantically separates content.

## Usage

### Horizontal

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-col gap-4 text-sm") do
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-1") do
    div(class: "leading-none font-medium") { "RubyUI" }
    div(class: "text-muted-foreground") { "An open-source UI component library." }
  end
  Separator()
  div { "Beautifully designed Phlex components that you can customize, extend, and build on." }
end
```

### Vertical

```ruby
div(class: "flex h-5 items-center gap-4 text-sm") do
  div { "Blog" }
  Separator(orientation: :vertical)
  div { "Docs" }
  Separator(orientation: :vertical)
  div { "Source" }
end
```

### Vertical Menu

```ruby
div(class: "flex items-center gap-2 text-sm md:gap-4") do
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-1") do
    span(class: "font-medium") { "Settings" }
    span(class: "text-xs text-muted-foreground") { "Manage preferences" }
  end
  Separator(orientation: :vertical)
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-1") do
    span(class: "font-medium") { "Account" }
    span(class: "text-xs text-muted-foreground") { "Profile & security" }
  end
  Separator(orientation: :vertical)
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-1") do
    span(class: "font-medium") { "Help" }
    span(class: "text-xs text-muted-foreground") { "Support & docs" }
  end
end
```

### In List

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm") do
  dl(class: "flex items-center justify-between") do
    dt { "Item 1" }
    dd(class: "text-muted-foreground") { "Value 1" }
  end
  Separator()
  dl(class: "flex items-center justify-between") do
    dt { "Item 2" }
    dd(class: "text-muted-foreground") { "Value 2" }
  end
  Separator()
  dl(class: "flex items-center justify-between") do
    dt { "Item 3" }
    dd(class: "text-muted-foreground") { "Value 3" }
  end
end
```

### Decorative

```ruby
div(class: "flex h-5 items-center gap-4 text-sm") do
  div { "Profile" }
  Separator(orientation: :vertical, decorative: true)
  div { "Settings" }
end
```

### As <hr>

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-col gap-4 text-sm") do
  div { "Section one" }
  Separator(as: :hr)
  div { "Section two" }
end
```
